text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq rejects Iranian claims on freeing Iraqi POWs.
- Russian Energy Minister Pyotr Rodionov in Baghdad.
- Trade ministry boosts supply of commodities at reduced prices.
- Iraq and Turkey resume official talks in Ankara.
- Iraq and Tunisia review cooperation in agricultural field.
- United Arab Emirates rules out Iran's participation in security arrangements in Gulf.
- Moroccan newspaper says Rolf Ekeus, chairman of the U.N. Special Commission on Iraq, is a card in United States hands to prolong sanctions on Baghdad.
- Heavy clashes reported between Turkish security forces and Turkish Kurd rebels.
- Vice-President Taha Muhieddin Ma'rouf receives Italian diplomat.
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary attacks British policies vis-a-vis Iraq.
- Article on the lessons to be learned from the United States vetoing of a U.N. Security Council resolution calling on Israel to rescind decision on building a new settlement in Jerusalem.
- French companies seek trade deals with Iraq.
- Commentary attacks anti-Iraq statements made by British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind in his latest visit to Saudi Arabia.
